name: holdout
description: Holdout — application de préparation aux crises, hors ligne (web + iOS via Capacitor)

scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.serve: npm run build:webapp && python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory www
scripts.deploy:site: node tools/build-site.mjs && npx --prefix server wrangler deploy --config site/wrangler.json
